verdict.rationale: YPOG's public notary downloads page offers free incorporation-related materials: a GmbH/UG foundation questionnaire and a GmbH-foundation starter kit. These cover the incorporation part of the story, although they appear to be intake and preparation aids for its notary service rather than ready-to-use incorporation documents. The SAFE and convertible content consists of explanatory briefings, not downloadable templates or generators. Missing for 10: SAFE/term sheet templates, NDA templates, any interactive document generator, actual incorporation document templates (articles/shareholder agreements), and explicit confirmation that use requires no client relationship.

support.subject: As a founder, I can use the firm's free public document generators or downloadable startup forms — incorporation documents, SAFEs/term sheets, NDAs — without being a client
